22, _ RESOLUTION ~ Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for Back
40 Subdivision, third filing, a replat of a portion of Lot 1, Block I Back 40 Subdivision
First Filing, Lot 1, Block 2 and Lot 1, Block 3 Back 40 Subdivision Second Filing, and Lot
1 Block 1 Cheyenne Ice & Events Center 4" Filing being situated in a portion of Section
1, Township 13 North, Range 67 West of the 6" P.M., City of Cheyenne, Laramie County,
Wyoming (located north of the intersection of Grant Avenue and W Lincolnway).
(SPONSOR ~ MR. COOK)

Mr. Segrave moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by unanimous voice
vote.

Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Brad Emmons, AVI
P.C., provided additional information. Committee member Segrave commented on the item.

23. RESOLUTION ~ Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for
Centennial Heritage, 2" Filing, a replat of Lots 8 thru 12, Block 2 Centennial Heritage and
a portion of the NW1/4 of Section 2, Township 13 North Range 66 West, City of Cheyenne,
Laramie County, Wyoming (located south of Raleigh Drive, near Savannah Drive and Taft
Avenue). (SPONSOR ~ MR. COOK)

Mr. Laybourn moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Segrave. Motion carried by unanimous voice
vote.

Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Shane Hanson, Steil
Surveying, was available for questions.

24. RESOLUTION — Expressing the will of the Governing Body recognizing the need to
provide City Boards, Commissions, and Councils with the tools they need to be effective,
efficient, and transparent. (SPONSORS — DR. ALDRICH, MR. LAYBOURN, DR.
RINNE AND MR. SEGRAVE)

Mr. Segrave moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by unanimous voice
vote.

Committee member Segrave provided an overview of the proposed resolution and committee
member Laybourn voiced support of the resolution.

26. | PRELIMINARY PLATS:

a) Preliminary Plat for Hill Heights Addition, 2" Filing, a replat of the north 132 feet
of the east 120 feet of the east 190 feet of the SE 1/4 of Tract 36, Hill Heights
Addition, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming.

Mr. Segrave moved to acknowledge the Planning Commission’s recommendation to approve with
staff recommendations 1-3 and the ability to include 10 lots in a similar orientation, seconded by
Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.
